from datetime import datetime

# Login to Spotify (once)
passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pw = None
for p in passwords:
    if p.get('account_name') == 'spotify':
        spotify_pw = p.get('password')
        break
print('spotify_pw_found', spotify_pw is not None)

spotify_token_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='jefsmith@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
print('login_resp_keys', list(spotify_token_resp.keys()))
spotify_token = spotify_token_resp.get('access_token')
print('spotify_token_len', len(spotify_token) if spotify_token else None)

# Fetch all songs from Spotify song library (pagination)
spotify_token = globals().get('spotify_token')
if not spotify_token:
    raise RuntimeError('Missing spotify_token')

page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
all_songs = []
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('song_library_page', page_index, 'items', len(resp) if resp else 0)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_songs.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

song_ids = [s['song_id'] for s in all_songs]
print('total_song_library_songs', len(song_ids), 'unique_song_ids', len(set(song_ids)))
# Keep only unique song_ids
song_ids_unique = sorted(set(song_ids))
print('first_10_song_ids', song_ids_unique[:10])

# Step 1: Fetch all playlists in Spotify playlist library (pagination)
spotify_token = globals().get('spotify_token')
page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
all_playlists = []
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('playlist_library_page', page_index, 'items', len(resp) if resp else 0)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

print('total_playlists', len(all_playlists))
# Gather song_ids per playlist
playlist_songs = {}  # playlist_id -> set(song_ids)
all_playlist_song_ids = []
for pl in all_playlists:
    pid = pl['playlist_id']
    sids = pl.get('song_ids') or []
    playlist_songs[pid] = set(sids)
    all_playlist_song_ids.extend(sids)

print('total_playlist_song_entries', len(all_playlist_song_ids), 'unique_song_ids_in_playlists', len(set(all_playlist_song_ids)))
print('first_5_playlists', [(p['playlist_id'], p['title'], len(p.get('song_ids') or [])) for p in all_playlists[:5]])

from datetime import datetime

# Build unique song IDs from both song library and playlists
song_ids_in_library = {s['song_id'] for s in all_songs}
song_ids_in_playlists = set(all_playlist_song_ids)
all_relevant_song_ids = sorted(song_ids_in_library | song_ids_in_playlists)
print('song_ids_in_library_count', len(song_ids_in_library))
print('song_ids_in_playlists_count', len(song_ids_in_playlists))
print('unique_relevant_song_ids_count', len(all_relevant_song_ids))
print('sample_relevant_song_ids', all_relevant_song_ids[:15])

# Fetch song details to get release_date
release_year = {}
release_date_str = {}
for i, sid in enumerate(all_relevant_song_ids):
    resp = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    # show_song doesn't require token per doc; proceed
    rd = resp.get('release_date')
    release_date_str[sid] = rd
    # Parse year
    if rd:
        # handle possible formats
        try:
            dt = datetime.fromisoformat(rd.replace('Z','+00:00'))
            release_year[sid] = dt.year
        except Exception as e:
            # fallback: take first 4 digits
            release_year[sid] = int(str(rd)[:4])
    else:
        release_year[sid] = None

    if i < 5:
        print('song', sid, 'release_date', rd, 'year', release_year[sid])

print('release_year_none_count', sum(1 for v in release_year.values() if v is None))

# Determine songs released after 2021
songs_after_2021 = {sid for sid, yr in release_year.items() if yr is not None and yr > 2021}
print('songs_after_2021_count', len(songs_after_2021))
print('songs_after_2021_sample', sorted(songs_after_2021)[:20])

# Split into those in song library and those only in playlists
songs_after_2021_in_library = sorted(song_ids_in_library & songs_after_2021)
songs_after_2021_in_playlists = sorted(song_ids_in_playlists & songs_after_2021)
print('songs_after_2021_in_song_library_count', len(songs_after_2021_in_library))
print('songs_after_2021_in_playlists_count', len(songs_after_2021_in_playlists))

# Remove songs from Spotify song library that were released after 2021
spotify_token = globals().get('spotify_token')
remove_ids = globals().get('song_ids_in_library_after_2021')
print('removing_from_library_count', len(remove_ids), 'ids', remove_ids)
results_lib = []
for sid in remove_ids:
    resp = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_library(song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
    results_lib.append((sid, resp))
    print('removed_from_library', sid, 'resp', resp)
print('library_removal_done', len(results_lib))

# Remove songs from playlists that were released after 2021
spotify_token = globals().get('spotify_token')
removal_pairs = globals().get('removal_pairs')
if spotify_token is None or removal_pairs is None:
    raise RuntimeError('Missing spotify_token or removal_pairs')

print('removal_pairs_count', len(removal_pairs))

pid_to_title = {pl['playlist_id']: pl['title'] for pl in globals().get('all_playlists', [])}

results_playlist = []
for idx, (pid, sid) in enumerate(removal_pairs):
    resp = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_playlist(playlist_id=pid, song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
    results_playlist.append((pid, sid, resp))
    if idx < 10:
        print('removed_from_playlist', 'playlist', pid, pid_to_title.get(pid), 'song', sid, 'resp', resp)

print('playlist_removal_done', len(results_playlist))
# Count failures if any
failures = [r for r in results_playlist if isinstance(r[2], dict) and 'message' in r[2] and 'failed' in r[2].get('message','').lower()]
print('failures_count', len(failures))

# Verification: check remaining after-2021 songs in library and playlists
spotify_token = globals().get('spotify_token')
songs_after_2021 = globals().get('songs_after_2021')

# Fetch song library again
page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
remaining_library_songs = []
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    remaining_library_songs.extend([s['song_id'] for s in resp])
    page_index += 1
remaining_library_ids = set(remaining_library_songs)
remaining_after_2021_in_library = remaining_library_ids & songs_after_2021
print('remaining_library_song_count', len(remaining_library_ids))
print('remaining_after_2021_in_library_count', len(remaining_after_2021_in_library))
print('remaining_after_2021_in_library_ids', sorted(remaining_after_2021_in_library))

# Fetch playlist library again
page_index = 0
all_playlists_verify = []
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_playlists_verify.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

remaining_after_2021_in_playlists = []
for pl in all_playlists_verify:
    sids = set(pl.get('song_ids') or [])
    for sid in sids & songs_after_2021:
        remaining_after_2021_in_playlists.append((pl['playlist_id'], sid))

print('playlists_count_verify', len(all_playlists_verify))
print('remaining_after_2021_song_entries_in_playlists_count', len(remaining_after_2021_in_playlists))
print('remaining_after_2021_song_entries_sample', remaining_after_2021_in_playlists[:10])
